result_text:
The region manager overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within a priority. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for the T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is the `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It is the same `CASE` ordering the sales-rep open-ticket list uses. I updated the Javadoc to match.

`RegionManagerService` builds the overview from that method, so it needed no change. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still excluded as before.
